title: Futuristic Transport System Moves Closer to Reality
main_content:
In the United States, a company is working on a project that could change the way we think about public transportation. Its planned system would move people around in steel tubes. Those passengers would be traveling at speeds of up to 1,200 kilometers per hour.

The futuristic steel tube transportation system is called Hyperloop.

The Hyperloop transport system is the idea of businessman Elon Musk. Dirk Ahlborn is head of Hyperloop Transportation Technologies. He says his company has taken Mr. Musk’s idea and is developing a system that will be safe, environmentally friendly and fast.

The system involves a series of capsules that float inside a long tube.These containers would not need to travel along a pathway or track. The system has been designed to operate above or below ground.

Dirk Ahlborn and his company will use an eight-kilometer track in Quay Valley to find the best way to set up passenger traffic and repair capsules.

If Mr. Ahlborn and his company succeed, we may one day see these very fast Hyperloop capsules speeding through tubes around the world.

questions.question: Who is Dirk Ahlborn?
options: A government official overseeing public transport
The head of Hyperloop Transportation Technologies
An engineer working independently on transportation
An investor providing funding for Elon Musk's projects
questions.answer: The head of Hyperloop Transportation Technologies

questions.question: Whose idea was the Hyperloop transport system?
options: A collaborative effort from multiple engineers
A project suggested by the government

questions.question: What may happen if the Hyperloop company succeeds?
options: The creation of conventional rail systems across the country
A revolutionary improvement in global public transportation
An increase in air travel reliance
Introduction of underground tunnels for cars
questions.answer: A revolutionary improvement in global public transportation
